changelog: Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice & DX11 SteamVR Display Hotfix v0.1.9
features: Resilient Process Candidate Detection: Launcher falls back gracefully when Windows UAC token restrictions block process path inspection on Steam games
Self-Healing DX11 Swapchain Lifecycle: Dx11LifecycleManager recovers automatically when games switch from intro/splash swapchains to the main game swapchain
Robust Direct3D 11 Device Querying: Added IDXGIDevice and ID3D11Device1 query interface fallbacks on swapchain discovery
Vulkan Coexistence: DXGIFactoryHook allows DXGI swapchain capture while SteamVR/Steam Overlay Vulkan layer is in background initialization
fixes: Fixed Sekiro and DX11 Steam titles displaying only on desktop monitor while SteamVR remains on starry idle background
Fixed candidate drop in injectionManager when non-elevated Get-Process query returns Access Denied
Fixed DXGIFactoryHook prematurely ignoring DXGI swapchains when Vulkan is INITIALIZING rather than RUNNING
Fixed Dx11LifecycleManager permanent degradation when initial swapchain fails device query
